verdict.rationale: The evidence covers in-platform signing of share-award contracts and grant documents, and attaching documents to historical transactions. It never mentions electronic share certificates, legally binding signatures on them, or certificates linked to specific cap table entries. Contract signing for equity awards is an adjacent feature, so it earns no credit toward this story.

support.subject: As a founder, I can issue electronic share certificates that are legally signed in-platform and permanently linked to the cap table entry they represent
